description: This file defines the AttendanceService class in the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating logic for managing attendance records, user permissions, workflow configurations, and integration with data access objects and workflow state machines.

classes.name: AttendanceService
classes.description: This class provides methods to manage employee attendance records, control user and supervisor permissions on attendance editing actions, and handle workflow configurations related to attendance states.

methods.name: savePunchRecord
methods.description: Saves an attendance punch record via the data access object.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlaps in punch out times for a given employee.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecords
methods.description: Checks for overlaps in punch in times for a given employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecord
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for a specific employee on a specific date.

methods.name: deleteAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Deletes an attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordById
methods.description: Fetches an attendance record by its ID.

methods.name: getTimezone
methods.description: Returns the timezone string corresponding to a given offset value.

methods.name: getTimezoneArray
methods.description: Provides an array of timezone offsets mapped to timezone strings.

methods.name: getLocalTimezone
methods.description: Determines the timezone string based on a client's timezone offset.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for punch-in overlaps when editing an existing record.

methods.name: checkForPunchOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for punch-out overlaps when editing an existing record.

methods.name: checkForPunchInOutOverLappingRecordsWhenEditing
methods.description: Checks for overlaps between punch-in and punch-out records during editing.

methods.name: searchAttendanceRecords
methods.description: Searches attendance records with optional filters such as employee ID, status, division, and date range.

methods.name: getLatestPunchInRecord
methods.description: Retrieves the latest punch-in record for an employee in a given state.

methods.name: getPunchTimeUserConfiguration
methods.description: Checks whether the user has configuration permissions for punch times.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsBetweenTwoDays
methods.description: Fetches attendance records between two specified dates for an employee.

methods.name: getAttendanceRecordsByEmpNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records for multiple employees within a date range.

methods.name: canUserChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the current user is allowed to change punch times, based on configuration.

methods.name: enableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Enables the current user to change punch times by setting workflow states.

methods.name: disableUserCanChangeCurrentTimeConfiguration
methods.description: Disables user's ability to change punch times by removing workflow states.

methods.name: enableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Allows user to modify attendance configuration by setting permissions.

methods.name: disableUserCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Disallows user from modifying attendance configuration by removing permissions.

methods.name: canSupervisorModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if a supervisor can modify attendance configurations.

methods.name: enableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Grants supervisor permissions to modify attendance configurations.

methods.name: disableSupervisorCanModifyAttendanceConfiguration
methods.description: Revokes supervisor permissions to modify attendance configurations.

methods.name: isAuthUserAllowedToPerformTheEditActions
methods.description: Determines if the authenticated user is authorized to perform edit actions on a given attendance record.

methods.name: saveConfiguration
methods.description: Saves workflow state configurations for attendance actions and states.
